label: Para Edit (fade the fluff)
description: The self-editing paragraph: a full serif paragraph on the page, an optional typed command line, then the CUT words recede into the paper while the KEPT words stay full-ink -- an edit performed as a visible diff, paid off with a verdict line. The product-demo-as-typography beat: show bloated copy, type the product's command, watch the fluff fade. Segments alternate kept and cut text.

segments.label: Paragraph segments in order: {text, cut: true|false}. Interleave kept sentences with cut fluff.

header.label: Small-caps label above the rule (e.g. 'THE FOLLOW-UP, UNEDITED')

command.label: Command typed on the CLI line before the edit fires (e.g. 'ask quotient to make it worth reading')

at.label: When the edit fires (seconds, default 2.6). The command types itself to finish just before.

fade_to.label: Opacity the cut words recede to (default 0.3)

verdict.label: Payoff line after the edit (e.g. '✓ 38 words cut. the story kept.')
